title: Homelab / Node Health
description: Per-node compute, hardware, network and disk health. Red markers are node reboots, orange are NIC link changes.

panels.title: Reboots (7d)
panels.description: Node reboots in the last 7 days. Anything unplanned here deserves a look.

panels.title: NIC link changes (7d)
panels.description: Physical NIC carrier changes. A switch or cable problem shows up here on every node at once.

panels.title: OOM kills (24h)
panels.description: Processes killed by the kernel for exceeding a memory limit, across all nodes.

panels.title: Nodes on battery
panels.description: Laptop nodes whose AC adapter is offline.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per node. Uptime under a day or any reboots/link changes are worth investigating.

targets.expr: max by (node) (label_replace((sum by (instance) (increase(node_network_carrier_changes_total{device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[7d]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((node_load1 / on (instance) count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"})) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{chip=~"platform_coretemp.*"})) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Pressure: time stalled (PSI)
panels.description: Share of time tasks were stalled waiting on CPU, memory or I/O. Sustained values above ~20% mean the node is saturated.

targets.expr: max by (node) (label_replace((node_load1 / on (instance) count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"})) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{chip=~"platform_coretemp.*"})) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))
max by (node, chip) (label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{chip=~"nvme.*"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

panels.title: NIC throughput
panels.description: Physical NIC traffic (tx drawn below zero).

targets.expr: max by (node) (label_replace((sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

min by (node) (label_replace((-sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

panels.title: NIC link state
panels.description: 1 = link up. The Nov 18 outage shows as every node dropping to 0 together.

targets.expr: min by (node) (label_replace((min by (instance) (node_network_carrier{device=~"en.*|eth.*"})) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

panels.title: TCP retransmits
panels.description: Rising retransmits mean packet loss somewhere between nodes.

targets.expr: max by (node) (label_replace((100 * node_nf_conntrack_entries / node_nf_conntrack_entries_limit) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

panels.title: System disk busy
panels.description: Time the node's own system disk (the one holding /var and Longhorn data) was busy.

targets.expr: max by (node) (label_replace((max by (instance) (rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left () (0 * label_replace(node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/var"}, "device", "$1", "device", "/dev/(nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+).*") + 1))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left () (0 * label_replace(node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/var"}, "device", "$1", "device", "/dev/(nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+).*") + 1))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace((sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, device) group_left () (0 * label_replace(node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/var"}, "device", "$1", "device", "/dev/(nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+).*") + 1))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))
